evals.name: add-redis-feature
evals.prompt: Add Redis to my devcontainer. I need it for caching in my Node.js app.
evals.expected_output: Updated devcontainer.json with Redis feature added, appropriate port forwarding (6379), and lifecycle scripts configured if needed.
assertions: Redis feature is included (ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/redis or similar)

evals.name: configure-port-forwarding
evals.prompt: I need to expose port 3000 and 8080 from my devcontainer so I can access my web app and API.
evals.expected_output: devcontainer.json with forwardPorts array containing 3000 and 8080, possibly with labels.

evals.name: update-node-version
evals.prompt: Update my devcontainer to use Node 20 instead of Node 18. I need the latest LTS.
evals.expected_output: Updated devcontainer.json with Node 20 feature or image reference.
assertions: Node version updated to 20 (in image or feature)
No syntax errors in the file
